How the score works

Weight each bonus by your attack/defense and red/blue preferences, then apply its mode weight and divide by building tiles. Regular has weight 1; GBG and GE share a combined weight of 1. Attack and defense share a combined weight of 2, and red and blue armies share a combined weight of 2. Defaults are attack ×1.5, defense ×0.5, GBG ×0.75 and GE ×0.25, with red and blue at ×1 each. All three priority sliders have five positions.

A 3% multiplier with a 20,000% base adds 600 percentage points per affected stat before weighting. Each multiplier uses your entered base independently. A boost to both armies contributes according to both army weights. Regular bonuses count once, even when they work in multiple modes. QI bonuses and special battle effects such as critical-hit chances are excluded. Mode columns and totals show weighted contributions, so scores reflect your priorities rather than the raw in-game bonus.

Above the highest known level, the last known boost is retained and marked ⚠. Its actual value at your target level is unconfirmed. Gaps between known levels stay missing; buildings with those gaps appear below the ranking. Bonuses with zero weight do not affect scores or warnings.
